test_cases.name: Electrical Arc Flash
test_cases.narrative: Technician opened a 440V 400A electric panel to energize jumbo equipment without verifying lockout tagout. Contact caused a phase-to-ground flash resulting in severe second degree burns to face and arms.

test_cases.name: High-Pressure Chemical Line Uncoupling
test_cases.narrative: During activation of a sodium sulphide pump, the discharge piping was uncoupled without depressurisation, spraying hazardous chemical solution into the work area and eyes of the operator.

test_cases.name: Scaffolding Elevated Fall Hazard
test_cases.narrative: Contractor climbed onto elevated structural scaffolding platform at 4.5m height to adjust cable tray without clipping harness lanyard to the anchor line. Worker slipped and fell, fracturing wrist.

test_cases.name: Manual Tool Minor Contusion
test_cases.narrative: While tightening a flange with a hand wrench, the tool slipped off the bolt head and bumped the operator's gloved knuckles, causing a minor superficial scratch. First aid applied on site.
